trap.label: preposição
trap.wrong: Doubt turned in certainty at the end.
trap.right: Doubt turned into certainty at the end.
trap.why: Em português “transformou-se em” e o aluno usa in. Em inglês, turn into expressa transformação.

fix.wrong: The villain turned to a hero.
fix.right: The villain turned into a hero.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com turn down: “They refused the offer.”
Reescreva com turn into: “The doubt became certainty.”
Reescreva com turn out: “It ended well.”
